description: List members of the Sejm (posłowie, MPs) in a term with their ID, name, club (klub), electoral district (okręg wyborczy), voivodeship (województwo) and whether they still hold the mandate (active). MPs who left during the term are included with active=false, so the list is longer than the 460 seats. Returns 100 MPs per page; narrow the list with club, name, district, voivodeship or active. Ask for more fields (e.g. profession, birthDate) with `fields`; get-member returns everything about one MP. The ID is the input of get-member, get-mp-voting-stats and get-mp-votings.

active.description: true: only MPs who hold their mandate now; false: only MPs whose mandate expired during the term (e.g. after election to the European Parliament); both by default

club.description: Only MPs of this club or circle (klub, koło), e.g. KO, PiS, PSL-TD, Lewica or Konfederacja, or niez. for MPs outside any club: the `id` from get-clubs, case-insensitive

district.description: Only MPs elected in this electoral district (okręg wyborczy): its number, e.g. 13, or the city it is named after, e.g. Kraków (a city can name more than one district)

fields.description: Extra fields to return for each MP, e.g. ["profession", "birthDate"]. By default only id, firstLastName, club, districtNum, districtName, voivodeship and active are returned

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return; defaults to 100

name.description: Only MPs whose name contains all these words, in any order, e.g. Tusk or Szymon Hołownia; case and Polish diacritics are ignored

offset.description: Number of items to skip, for pagination; defaults to 0

term.description: Term of the Sejm (kadencja), e.g. 10; defaults to the current term (see get-terms)

voivodeship.description: Only MPs elected in this voivodeship (województwo, one of the 16 regions of Poland), e.g. mazowieckie or śląskie; Polish diacritics are optional

name: get-members

active.description: Whether the mandate is still held

club.description: ID of the MP's club (see get-clubs)

districtNum.description: Number of the electoral district (okręg wyborczy)

id.description: MP ID, used by the other MP tools

inactiveCause.description: Why the mandate expired, for inactive MPs

nextOffset.description: Pass as `offset` to get the next page; absent on the last page

notice.description: Set when the Sejm API is unavailable and the data comes from a cache; it may be out of date

offset.description: Number of matching items skipped before this page

total.description: Number of matching items on all pages

title: List MPs
